breakpoints.note: 19 custom media queries (-up, -down, -only per breakpoint) in dist/css/media-queries.css.

elevation.note: 23 shadow tokens: numbered levels plus bevel, inset and button shadows.

structure.note: No public ramps: 225 role tokens named color-<element>-<role>-<state> (per element: bg 96, text 49, border 22, tooltip 2, icon 18, avatar 16, backdrop 1, button 1, checkbox 2, input 6, nav 5, radio 2, video 3, scrollbar 2). Values not recorded (licence).

findings: No token for direction, language or script. One sans stack led by 'Inter'; three negative letter-spacing tokens (dense, denser, densest) used by headings, which must not apply to Arabic.

Density is responsive, not a mode: controls are taller and input text larger below the md breakpoint (48em) — button medium 32px → 28px, input text 16px/24px → 13px/20px — i.e. "touch" is inferred from viewport width, not from pointer type. A p-theme-light-mobile theme changes shadows only.
Default desktop UI text is 13px on a 20px line (ratio 1.54); button labels are 12px on 16px (1.33).
Component CSS uses logical properties (198 matching lines in the scanned files). Locale files with Arabic strings: none.

gaps: Colour and shadow values intentionally omitted (licence restricts use to Shopify-integrated or visually distinct applications).
No focus-ring or container tokens; no touch-target token.
No explicit density mode; responsive sizes only.
